question: On REAL Chinese speech, do the ORIGINAL (un-fine-tuned) Smart Turn v3.2 and turn-1-mini hold a pre-registered operating point (false cutoff <= 10% AND missed END <= 10%), and do they beat a model-free baseline?

protocol.reuse: the SAME sweep core P0.7/P0.11/P0.13 use; the two models share one scorer so a frontier difference is the model, not the scorer
protocol.policySemantics: hold_model_fire = max(actionDelay, holdFire); cutoff = (fired & holdDur > max(actionDelay,fire)) | holdDur > timeout; detect = eotFired & eotFire <= timeout
protocol.fireTest: p_eot >= threshold (protocol.mts spanFire) — the shared, deliberate deviation from eot-bench `>`
protocol.degenerateThreshold: threshold <= 0.02 dropped from DECISION sets (AC3) — p_eot >= 0.02 fires on almost any cell
protocol.crossModelThreshold: Smart Turn and turn-1-mini thresholds are SEPARATE probability spaces; the report never compares the two threshold NUMBERS, only their frontiers (AC3)
protocol.heldOut: per-model operating point SELECTED on a clip-disjoint half, REPORTED on the other half (AC4); selection set != reporting set
protocol.smartTurnWindow: predictEndpoint rule: last 8 s, front-padded with zeros when the prefix is shorter
protocol.turn1miniSlice: frame j ends at sample (j+1)*320; a cell whose prefix ends at E reads frame floor(E/320)-1

baselines.fixedWait: fires at exactly W seconds of silence — uses NO audio; knob W in seconds
baselines.vad: the SHIPPING rule: StreamingVad + thresholdsFor from src/shared/voiceEndpoint.ts driven over the span prefix; knob = endpoint ms

provenance.reuseNote: checkpoint revisions, ONNX sha256, and the turn-1-mini preprocessing path are copied VERBATIM from P0.13 (english-smart-turn-vs-turn1mini) — no version was re-selected and nothing there was modified

corpora.naturalDialogueNote: both corpora are REAL Chinese speech and are reported SEPARATELY (AC2). thchs30-zh-scripted is scripted single-utterance reads, so its END is a scripted sentence-final boundary, NOT a conversational turn end. ascend-zh-natural-dialogue is spontaneous conversation, but (a) it is code-switched (rows kept are zh|mixed, so most clips contain English too) and (b) the ADMITTED set is small and clusters into a few sessions/speakers, so its per-rate Wilson intervals are WIDE and the clips are not independent samples — the confidence statement in CONCLUSION.md is bounded accordingly and the natural-corpus sample size is stated explicitly rather than omitted

smart-turn-v3.2.frontend: compiled native mel addon (addon already built)

selfCheck.streamVsOfflineNote: CHARACTERISATION, not a gate. single-push last frame carries the non-causal lowpass right-edge; the chunked interior carries the per-chunk resampler edge handling. Neither is the model-identity test — that is onnxVsTorchStreamLowpass (ONNX graph vs torch causal stream).
